source.title: Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus USA400 Clone, Italy
source.primary_article_boundary: Article body on journal page 995; references continue at top of 996; unrelated next letter begins on 996 and is excluded.

semantic_spot_checks.finding: ATOM objective matches the source statement that the authors describe importation of USA400/ST1 into Italy.
ATOM preserves amoxicillin/clavulanate 1 g three times daily for 10 days and levofloxacin 500 mg once daily for 7 days.
ATOM preserves USA400/ST1, SCCmec IVa, PVL-positive, agr III, and spa t128.
ATOM preserves complete resolution and no recurrence for more than one year without converting the observation into treatment-effect evidence.

source_integrity_notes: The PDF contains the target letter plus the beginning of an unrelated Angiostrongylus cantonensis letter on journal page 996. The unrelated letter is excluded from ATOM and SEA evidence.
The article has no main-text figures, tables, algorithms, workflows, appendices, or supplements.
Background epidemiologic claims that depend on the article bibliography were not converted into primary-study result atoms.
Model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
